responsibility: This file is the thin runtime wrapper around the underlying system storage allocator in mc-boot. It forwards ALLOCATE, DEALLOCATE, REALLOCATE, and availability checks directly to SysStorage, providing the canonical Modula-2-facing heap-management entry points that other runtime modules use instead of calling the system allocator layer directly.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation half of the GStorage pair: its code only forwards Storage_ALLOCATE/DEALLOCATE/REALLOCATE/Available to SysStorage at runtime, whereas gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStorage.h contains just the exported declarations for those wrapper entry points.
